reviews.reviewer: claude-pro (Opus, effort xhigh), read-only database review
reviews.summary: Read the migration and tests before commit (now 91502a5). SQL cleared as written: exact match on two keys, archive before insert, max(version)+1 incl. drafts, fields carried, no-op when nothing matches, lock and temp table safe in the runner, v0.16.1 compatible. Blocking before release (F1): record the approval, a read-only production pre-check and the compatibility statement. LOW: negative fixture should contain the old name without equalling it (F2); a schema_migrations assertion is padding (F3); no audit row, optional (F4).

reviews.reviewer: claude-pro (Opus, effort xhigh), read-only infrastructure and security review
reviews.summary: No exposure off the tailnet, no prod/dev mix-up, sign-in works. HIGH F1: a userspace tailscaled on the VPS forwards unserved ports to host loopback, opening the prod backend, Postgres, SSH and more to the tailnet; needs tagged key, mandatory ACL and port checks. MEDIUM F2: untagged key expiry drops the console. LOW: /api/metrics and client-address note (F3), false health-check note (F4), install/restart steps (F5), implicit default server (F6), state dir mode (F7), stale allowlist doc (F8), stale admin.beonedge.in refs (F9), subject wording (F10).

reviews.reviewer: claude-pro (Opus, effort xhigh), follow-up on the fix commit
reviews.summary: F1 closed: the container leaves no tailnet path to any host service but nginx on 47491; F2, F3, F4, F5, F7, F8 closed; F6 and F9 deferred. New HIGH N1: ufw drops the container's connection to 10.251.47.1:47491, so the prod console would not load, and the operator manual forbade the needed rule. MEDIUM N2: the access rule only grants, so broader grants must be removed and policy tests added; nc checks cannot prove it. LOW N3 health wording, N4 redeploy runs from the build machine.

N1 fixed: the compose network names its bridge boepadmin0; DEPLOY.md step 1 adds exactly 'ufw allow in on boepadmin0 from 10.251.47.0/24 to 10.251.47.1 port 47491 proto tcp', and OPERATOR_MANUAL_STEPS section 6 names 47491 as the one exception. N2 fixed: merge into the existing acls, remove or narrow wider grants covering the tag, policy tests for operator accept 443 / deny 22, 47413 and non-operator deny 443; nc -w 5 and a note that only the tests prove the rule. N3 and N4 wording fixed. Compose validates. F6 (default server) and F9 (stale admin.beonedge.in refs) stay deferred.
